channel.title: Diagrams with Mermaid :: Coursebook Informatics
channel.description: Mermaid draws diagrams from text. You describe in a few lines which boxes there are and which arrows connect them, and Mermaid turns that into a picture. Because the diagram is just text, it lives right inside your Markdown file, can be versioned with Git and is changed in seconds. No drawing program, no screenshot that goes out of date.
